scripts.test: npm run build && npm run build:firefox && node --test tests/*.test.js
scripts.format: prettier --write src styles scripts tests index.html
scripts.lint:firefox: npm run build:firefox && web-ext lint --source-dir build/firefox
scripts.package:firefox: npm run build:firefox && web-ext build --source-dir build/firefox --artifacts-dir build/packages --overwrite-dest
scripts.lint: npm run lint:js && npm run lint:css
scripts.format:check: prettier --check src styles scripts tests index.html
